role: Independent scientific reviewer original-source replay, retained without modifying its completed result.

external_script.scope: Environment-bound independent reviewer replay; retained externally, no source bodies embedded. Uses exact original XML, Rhea RDF, ChEBI JSON, UniProt JSON and ENA sequence, not authored projection labels.

scope_limits: Replay covers the assertions enumerated in its 63 checks; it is not a substitute for primary-text/figure interpretation or graph visual inspection.
Original absolute paths are session locations. Reacquisition requires matching source hashes.
The independent structured review bundle is saved separately with its own exact input bindings.
